                                                  AGENDA

                   HARBORVIEW CITY COUNCIL - TUESDAY, MARCH 10, 2026

                                   REGULAR MEETING AT 6:00 P.M.
                                 Harborview City Hall, Council Chambers
                                      Pier Lane, Harborview

                                            Watch Online:
                         Watch on Webinar: https://example.invalid/council
                                   Listen by phone: (555) 010-0199

This meeting will be held in-person.

How to participate in the meeting:
  • You are welcome to come to the meeting and provide public comment in person. Each speaker will
      have 2-minutes to provide public comment per agenda item.
  • Submit your comments by email to clerk@harborview.example by 4:00 p.m. the day of the
      meeting.

    OPEN TIME FOR PUBLIC EXPRESSION – 10 MINUTES
    Members of the public may speak to the City Council on items that are not on the agenda and are
    within the Council’s jurisdiction.

    CITY MANAGER AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS:
